assets.name: icon_look
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite, ONE isolated object on genuinely TRANSPARENT background with real alpha (not white, not checkerboard). Reference image is the approved MATERIAL AND CONSTRUCTION style, not a layout to reproduce. Physical hand-cut corrugated cardboard collage, colored fibrous paper layers, visible corrugation only at edges, a few natural glue/scissor imperfections, soft daylight upper left. Straight-on orthographic paper piece, shallow 2mm thickness, all sharp and in focus, no cast shadow extending outside object. Keep chunky simple geometry readable at 50 pixels. No text, no watermarks, no extra props, no scenery, no glossy CGI, no black outlines, no vector illustration. Output a square canvas. ONE simple safety-action icon: a pair of two large oval ivory paper eyes with dark brown circular paper pupils, arranged horizontally, mounted on a single irregular kraft cardboard backing. No eyelashes, no face, no other anatomy. Instantly reads as LOOK BOTH WAYS. Fills middle 85% width and 60% height of square.
